payload.headline: Apply the global claude worker patch you chose in q-nt7ptsq2nd, then answer Applied

parts.cause: Confined heads cannot write ~/.fgos/config.yaml. Config lists are leaves, so the patch carries all four claude invocations copied from the standard; only claude-cli-bwrap gains --allowedTools "Bash(cargo:*),Bash(node:*),Bash(npm test:*)".

options.does: You ran the command; the supervisor wakes the lead to rerun phase 2 on claude-cli-bwrap.
options.harm: While the override stands, later standard edits to claude invocations do not reach this machine until it is unset (plan 261124-2320 moves the grant into the standard).
options.label: Applied

options.does: Leave the patch unapplied; phase 2 stays parked.
options.label: Hold

parts.recommendation: Applied: it is the route you already chose; the file only adds the grant you named.

scope.allows: The supervisor wakes the lead of plan 261124-0004 to rerun phase 2 on the default claude-cli-bwrap invocation.
scope.forbids: Any other change to global config, other invocations, executors or plan scope.

parts.what: Your answer to q-nt7ptsq2nd chose a global config patch so claude-cli-bwrap workers may run cargo, node and npm test. The exact patch is ready: plans/261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner/reports/claude-worker-global-patch.yaml. Run from the main checkout: fgos config patch --global plans/261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner/reports/claude-worker-global-patch.yaml --reason "owner q-nt7ptsq2nd: claude-cli-bwrap workers may run cargo, node and npm test"
